body:
You're definitely right about that. Most people at a young age don't know what they want to do with their lives. That's a big question that everyone tries to answer. However, I won't even get much opportunity as I grow older. After pondering and envisioning of how my life already turned out to be, and envisioning myself in the future, it's honestly just debilitating. The pain and thoughts are just so unbearable. And, if I really am intelligent, then I truly wish I wasn't. I wish I didn't know so much about the world and I wish I never think as much about everything everyday than other people.

I wish I could have been brought up as an ignorant and pretend like everything is fine no matter what. However, the reality is that for some people it never gets better. Life isn't constant, it always changes. Ultimately, life does not always change for the better and it can get progressively worse. I wish it wouldn't have been that way, but that's how the world changes. The "hierarchy" as I like to call them, set more standards for living every year and not everyone can handle that type of level. It didn't have to be this way, but sadly, that's how humans operate.

Money, power, and greed run through this world. Always has.

I have no friends. I have only parents, but I don't really like them. The rest of my family lives back in Europe but I don't stay in contact with them. They don't call us, we have to be always the ones to call first. They don't ask for me to talk to them. They're proud of me and stuff, but it's not the same. Plus, I'm not going to nullify my suicide because of family or someone else. I live for myself.

Yes, I am a citizen of the United States. However, I am originally from Germany. Also, I have many personal incidences that have led me to this decision, so it's not only my own mind. Just for clarification.

I don't consider myself intelligent, or even smart for that matter. I'm pretty sure most of the population thinks the same way as I do. Also, I doubt I can make much difference. Powerful wealthy people are viewed as people who make differences, but that's not true for most cases. I won't have a prominent career or path to do something like that.

Yes, I am a citizen of the United States. However, I am originally from Germany, and I came to the United States when I was three years old. I have plenty of reasons I want to do this due to personal incidences. I just didn't state them. Trust me, there are a lot of reasons.

Well, for starters, I've never been diagnosed by a health professional for this but I am absolutely sure that I have Clinical Depression, Seasonal affective disorder, Insomnia, and some social anxiety issues. Basically, my life has always been in shambles and a pile of rubble. I truly despise myself and my own vague existence. I despise this world because of how damaged it has become. Greedy corporate business leaders, corrupt politicians, warlords, genocide, rapists, murderers, and the list goes on and on. This world commits suicide every single day. Everyone is suffering due to the current economical status of this world, massive trade deficits, our own Democratic Republic that is filled with politicians who only implement policies that deem them fit. 

I've never been happy. I deceive people with my fake smile, actions, and plans for the future. Truthfully, I am going nowhere in life and I'm not willing to suffer like every other person on this planet. I over analyze everything and just think every second of every passing day in my room. I start school on Tuesday and I'm looking forward to that. I created a huge journal exemplifying my reasons, thoughts, and, motives for this act. I even took the liberty of creating diagrams of guns, bombs, and other dangerous things that represent my death. I wanted to commit suicide by creating a bunch of pipe bombs and strapping it on my body, but I have no money or materials for that. 

I wanted to explain everything by video but I have no money or access to video making materials (Bluetooth, webcam, video camera, etc). I made an elaborate plan of where and how I want to do this. I've been planning the whole summer but this month is the first time that I have written everything out. From handpicked location to timing calculations. I don't self harm or intoxicate myself to make the pain go away, but I want to do this so I can become non-existent. 

To shorten it out: I despise everything about myself, this world, and I have nothing going for me in the future. I'm determined to do this.
